title: CFB Game Total — mobile + production certification Step 8
problem: The final rebuild step must certify the frozen Page-1 to Page-2 CFB Game Total flow on public production across mobile/tablet/desktop and close the known production identity drift without reopening Steps 1-7.
root_cause: DevSystem production verification V5 failed before browser verification because devsystem/production_targets_v1.json still certified Render commit c62c17b74704101bd5ddf05f32476d9fe4e14126 while the configured immutable service and branch were live on 879c28265efde1810a5e30352fa2dcb269c1052a. The first Step-8 public proof then exposed a certification-only compatibility bug: browser_qa_v1._find_app_frame requires at least one combobox, while the rebuilt native CFB Game Total frame correctly renders with zero comboboxes. Production frame evidence showed the CFB Game Total body was present; no product runtime defect was established.
patch: Update only the certified Render commit pointer and add a non-mutating final Step-8 public certification owner, test, Runless plan, and ledger. The cert uses native CFB frame markers/testids rather than the obsolete combobox gate, verifies Render /health/details identity, Page-1 Phoenix day + exact-event cards, exact-event Page-2 activation, required Page-2 surfaces, no runtime-error/data-limited copy, and no horizontal overflow at 390/430/768/1440. Product runtime remains byte-for-byte frozen.
protected_scope: CFB Game Total Steps 1-7 frozen artifacts
